content.comment_body: Good morning. I have been using Excel along with [product_name] and [product_name] to transfer data to Excel from [product_name]. However, I am unable to figure out how to set up an application or an Excel button to switch an output on or off in [product_name]. Thank you in advance for your assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: A user describes difficulties controlling a [product_name] output directly from Excel using [product_name]. Although transferring data to Excel is possible, there is uncertainty about how to create a usable button in Excel for toggling hardware outputs, pointing to documentation or feature gaps.
